{{Quote|Only a Padawan, but a Jedi just the same.|Trachta|<ref name="GP3" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Padawan/Legends|'''Padawan''']] served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Like other Jedi during the war, he fell to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], betraying the Order and joining [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==Biography==
===The Clone Wars===
{{Quote|We were on Noctralis... hunting down another Jedi who defected to Count Dooku's side. <...> He saved a thermal detonator for us. That blast was the last thing I ever saw with my real eyes.|Trachta's memories|<ref name="GP3" />}}
[[File:Noctralis.jpg|thumb|left|Trachta and his troopers hunting the Padawan.]]A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], attaining the rank of [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] by the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Taking up the rank of [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Commander]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], he fell to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and joined [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] group of [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolytes]]. Soon, he began fighting for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] against the Jedi and the Republic. On the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Noctralis]], the former Padawan [[Mission to Noctralis|was attacked]] by [[Trachta]], an agent of the Republic who had been tasked with tracking down Jedi defectors. Trachta and several [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] surrounded the Padawan, but he armed a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] and used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Throw|throw]] it at Trachta and his men. The clones were incinerated, as were Trachta's arms and eyes. While the Padawan's pursuers were either dead or wounded, he still ended up incarcerated within the clandestine Jedi [[Prison/Legends|prison]] known as [[The Prism]].<ref name="GP3" />

===After the war===
{{Quote|Lieutenant Tohm, seal the cell. I'm going to be here for hours.''"<br />"''No! Wait&mdash;|Trachta and the dark Padawan|<ref name="GP3" />}}
[[File:APadawanDefectorInThePrism.jpg|right|thumb|280px|The former Jedi Padawan locked in a cell at the Prism prison]]
When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] rose from the ashes of the Republic at the end of the war and the Jedi Order disbanded, the secret prison remained ignorant to the fact that the Republic was no more. During the Empire's [[19 BBY/Legends|first year]], a [[Ghost Prison incident|military coup]] instigated by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Gentis]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] forced [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], Trachta and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Laurita Tohm]] to bring [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to seek a safe haven where the Emperor could recuperate. Vader brought the group to the Prism, the only location he believed would be safe from traitors within the Empire borders. After killing the Prism's [[Unidentified Prism Jedi|Jedi warden]], Tohm began to review the files detailing the facility's prisoners. Trachta discovered that the fallen Padawan who had caused his grievous injuries was still imprisoned there. Trachta and Tohm found the fallen Jedi's cell within the prison and opened it up, confusing the Padawan. He believed that he was going to be served a meal, and recoiled in horror when he saw who entered his cell. Trachta told Tohm to seal the cell behind him, as he would not be leaving for many hours. He then began to savagely beat the Jedi with his [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] fists, exacting bloody revenge, while the Padawan begged for him to stop.<ref name="GP3" />
